visualCharacteristics.layout: single-column stack, small image left, name top-right, large price bottom-right
visualCharacteristics.notes: black tiles with grey border and rounded corners; source is a personalized merchandising reel - prices are a static snapshot

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per product. Cell 1 = product image; Cell 2 = paragraph with the linked product name, then a price paragraph (e.g. bold $2,095.99). The name link makes the whole tile clickable; prices are static authored text
